| **What it is** | A web MVP for planning a date course together, built in a university club's industry project program |
| **Features** | No sign-up needed: join a shared room with a nickname and edit the course together in real time |
| **Tools** | Next.js, React, JavaScript, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Kakao Maps, Vercel |
| **Links** | [Live demo](https://travel-szul.vercel.app) · Repository private |
